name: Them Crooked Vultures

essentialTracks.title: No One Loves Me & Neither Do I

lyricQuotes: New fang, new fang / Got it in my mouth

shortBio.en: Homme / Grohl / Jones hard-rock trio; one self-titled album, 2009–2010.
shortBio.zh: Homme / Grohl / Jones hard-rock 三人组；一张同名专辑，2009–2010。

body.en:
Active mainly 2009–2010. The debut album stacks Homme’s desert riffs, Grohl’s drums (and some vocal), and Jones’s bass/keys—Zeppelin arranging habits meeting QOTSA and Foo Fighters methods.

Short catalog; the lineup itself is the main object of interest: mid-career players forming a one-album hard-rock unit.
body.zh:
主要活动于 2009–2010。首专叠放 Homme 的沙漠 riff、Grohl 的鼓（及部分人声）与 Jones 的贝斯/键盘——Zeppelin 编曲习惯遇见 QOTSA 与 Foo Fighters 方法。

目录很短；阵容本身是主要兴趣对象：中后期职业乐手组成一张专辑的 hard-rock 单位。

whyMatters.en: 2009–10 hard-rock trio: Josh Homme, Dave Grohl, John Paul Jones. One self-titled album; cross-decade personnel from QOTSA, Foo Fighters, and Led Zeppelin.
whyMatters.zh: 2009–10 hard-rock 三人组：Josh Homme、Dave Grohl、John Paul Jones。一张同名专辑；人事来自 QOTSA、Foo Fighters 与 Led Zeppelin。

note.en: Debut single—Homme riff, Grohl crash, Jones bass fill; power-trio writing.
note.zh: 首支单曲——Homme riff、Grohl crash、Jones 贝斯 fill；power trio 写法。

note.en: Grohl lead-vocal trade-off; Foo, QOTSA, and Zeppelin syntax in one track.
note.zh: Grohl 主唱交接；一曲内 Foo、QOTSA 与 Zeppelin 语法。

note.en: Blues-rock slow burn; Jones keys under Homme’s low vocal.
note.zh: Blues-rock 慢燃；Jones 键盘垫 Homme 低人声。

body.en:
Homme, Grohl, and Jones recorded in Los Angeles after years of mutual guest spots. No audition—three established players, one album contract.

Homme produced; Grohl drummed; Jones played bass and added Mellotron/keys where the arrangement needed density.

Them Crooked Vultures (2009) is the only studio LP—a deliberate short run.
body.zh:
Homme、Grohl、Jones 在多年互作客座后于洛杉矶录音。无 audition——三位成熟乐手，一张专辑合约。

Homme 制作；Grohl 打鼓；Jones 贝斯并在编曲需密度处加 Mellotron/键盘。

Them Crooked Vultures（2009）是唯一录音室 LP——刻意短跑。

body.en:
Mind Eraser, No Chaser splits lead vocal between Homme and Grohl—no fixed frontman hierarchy.

No One Loves Me & Neither Do I uses Jones keyboard stabs in the manner of Zeppelin’s No Quarter texture.

Mix stays dry and midrange-forward—QOTSA desert production with Zeppelin arrangement density.
body.zh:
Mind Eraser, No Chaser 在 Homme 与 Grohl 间分主唱——无固定 frontman 等级。

No One Loves Me & Neither Do I 用 Jones 键盘刺击，接近 Zeppelin No Quarter 纹理。

混音保持干、中频前置——QOTSA 沙漠制作加 Zeppelin 编曲密度。

body.en:
The band toured Europe and the US in 2010—live sets extended album tracks with jam middle sections.

No second album followed; members returned to Foo Fighters, QOTSA, and Jones’s session work.

TCV remains a personnel-bridge record: Zeppelin bass player, Nirvana/Foo drummer, and desert-rock guitarist in one trio.
body.zh:
2010 年欧美巡演——现场用 jam 中段延长专辑曲。

无第二张专辑；成员回 Foo Fighters、QOTSA 与 Jones session 工作。

TCV 仍是人事桥接唱片：Zeppelin 贝斯手、Nirvana/Foo 鼓手与沙漠摇滚吉他手组成三人组。
